_readme: Modal census golden — every modal call site under src/, as per-file, per-kind counts, frozen.

Compared verbatim by tests/uat/test_uat_modal_census.cpp (UAT-XCT-091, docs/uat/06-cross-cutting.md). A new exec()/QMessageBox-static/QInputDialog/QFileDialog/QColorDialog/QFontDialog call site anywhere under src/ fails the release gate until this file changes.

OWNER-ACK RULE: a change to this file merges ONLY with the owner's explicit acknowledgment in the PR and a cited accepted decision record in docs/decision-records/. Agents do not self-approve golden diffs (AGENTS.md, G6/G10).

Scope: argumentless .exec()/->exec() (dialogs, boxes, progress dialogs — and, indistinguishably by grep, event loops and qApp->exec(), frozen alongside rather than risking a matcher hole). QMenu::exec(pos) is a transient popup and is out of scope. The 2026-08-28 baseline is a faithful FREEZE — nothing was pruned; each row is the owner's pruning worksheet.
Regenerate after an approved change: TRAILER_CENSUS_WRITE=1 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ./test_uat_modal_census
